title: LUST | It Watches Back
description:
Every night, a kind voice told him it was fine. Every night, the thing behind him got a little closer.

LUST | It Watches Back is an animated short film about the habit that feeds on you in the dark, and the morning he finally fought back.

When did you last feel watched by your own habit? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #horror #selfimprovement #motivation
